listing: Lodelicious Gifts & Sweets, 5.0 stars, 34 Google reviews

reviews.name: Joe R.
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing shop! Geared towards families and children. What a wonderful experience and chocolate!!! Owner is the nicest gentlemen!

reviews.name: Morgan T.
reviews.text: Went there this summer with my sons and sister. We got the Dubai chocolate strawberries and gelato…. Delicious!!! The environment is clean and welcoming and the staff made my sons smile from ear to ear!

reviews.name: Ali M.
reviews.text: I absolutely loved this place! They have such a great selection of gifts, chocolates, candies, and custom gift baskets. Everything was high quality and beautifully put together.

reviews.name: Marwan I.
reviews.text: One of the best desserts I've ever had, the strawberry Dubai chocolate cup was definitely 10/10!! I definitely recommend!!

reviews.name: Amy
reviews.text: Visit Lodelicious, a brand new gift and sweets shop in Manomet! I tried the chocolate covered pretzels and the chocolate dipped oranges. They were oh so delicious!

reviews.name: Mark M.
reviews.text: They had soooo much good candy, snacks and ice cream, they even have DUBAI CHOCOLATE ICE CREAM. The place is amazing, good customer service and overall amazing people.

reviews.name: Jeremy B.
reviews.text: Wonderful gelato, fudge, Dubai cups, and the homegrown friendly service you would expect at a family-run establishment.
